{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the 6 values with commas
comma_rows = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Rows with commas in revenue:")
print(sales.loc[comma_rows, 'revenue'])

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the first few cleaned values
print("\nFirst 10 cleaned revenue values:")
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head(10))"}
